subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: When a document carries an in-scope `delivery:` citation (per FR-9) whose anchor resolves to a journal `E-n` entry, the cross-document arm shall report no defect.
rationale: legal `delivery:<slug>#E-n` citations are the audit trail's normal form (F-6); the guard must be silent on them
fit_criterion: on the legal-`E-n`-citation fixture, the cross-document arm reports zero defects
